resources.string:
Vyzorix is a headless device agent. It has no app screen to open and no button to press, so this accessibility switch is the one gesture that tells the phone "yes, run" — and it is the only reliable way to start something before the user has opened an app, which Android otherwise blocks for background services.
Enabling this does two things. First, it posts the persistent Vyzorix notification, whose "Start Vyzorix" action starts the agent. Second, it hides the Vyzorix launcher icon, because a headless agent has nothing to open once it is armed; turning this switch off brings the icon back.
This service observes nothing and acts on nothing. It does not read your screen, does not read what you type, does not tap or scroll for you, and does not look at other apps. It receives no accessibility events and performs no accessibility actions — the switch is its entire purpose. Nothing about your activity on this device is collected by it.
